{"CommandLine":"bash -c '
ENVF="/mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/handoff/.agf_env"
export ELAN_HOME="$(grep -m1 "^AGF_ELAN_HOME=" "$ENVF" | cut -d= -f2-)"
LEAN="$ELAN_HOME/bin/lean"
export LEAN_PATH="$(cat /mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/handoff/.agf_lean_path)"

cat << "EOF" > /tmp/test_lemma3.lean
import Mathlib
import LeanProject.GraphInvariantsComputable

open SimpleGraph

lemma radius_le_eccentricity {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (v : V) :
    GraphCalc.radius G ≤ GraphCalc.eccentricity G v := by
  unfold GraphCalc.radius
  have h_mem : GraphCalc.eccentricity G v ∈ Finset.image (GraphCalc.eccentricity G) Finset.univ := by
    rw [Finset.mem_image]
    exact ⟨v, Finset.mem_univ v, rfl⟩
  have h_nonempty : (Finset.image (GraphCalc.eccentricity G) Finset.univ).Nonempty :=
    ⟨GraphCalc.eccentricity G v, h_mem⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Finset.min_of_nonempty h_nonempty
  rw [hm]
  dsimp
  have hm_le := Finset.min_le_of_mem h_mem hm
  exact hm_le

EOF

"$LEAN" /tmp/test_lemma3.lean
echo "Exit: $?"
